Print the multiplication table of a number using a while loop.

Supplied answer
n = int(input("Enter a number: "))
i = 1
while i <= 10:
    print(f"{n} x {i} = {n * i}")
    i += 1
Note: Loop on the counter (i <= 10), not on n - a common slip.
